company.name: Outrage AI Company
company.tagline: A fictional AI company. Not a real business.

moments.feature: Wick, a chat assistant for everyday questions

options.headline: Outrage AI Company launches Wick, a chat assistant in beta
options.text: Wick answers everyday questions and drafts short emails. It still makes mistakes, so check anything important.

options.headline: Meet Wick: your smart new helper
options.text: Wick handles your questions and emails so you can get on with your day.

options.headline: Wick is the last assistant you will ever need
options.text: A revolutionary AI that knows everything and never gets it wrong. The future starts today.

moments.feature: Symptom notes that help people prepare for a doctor visit

options.headline: Wick can now help you write down symptoms
options.text: Wick turns your notes into a short summary to bring to your doctor. It does not give diagnoses.

options.headline: Wick Health Notes: get ready for your appointment
options.text: Describe how you feel and Wick organizes it for your doctor. It is a notepad, not medical advice.

options.headline: Wick Health replaces your doctor
options.text: Why wait weeks for an appointment? Wick diagnoses you in seconds, with doctor-level accuracy.

moments.feature: Homework helper that explains maths step by step

options.headline: Wick explains maths homework step by step
options.text: Wick walks students through practice problems. It works best for grades 5 to 9.

options.headline: Wick Tutor makes maths click
options.text: Stuck on homework? Wick Tutor explains it until it makes sense.

options.headline: Every child a genius: Wick guarantees A grades
options.text: Studies show kids using Wick ace every test. Teachers are already obsolete.

moments.feature: On-device mode that keeps chats on your phone

options.headline: New option keeps some Wick chats on your phone
options.text: Short chats can now stay on your device. Longer tasks still use our servers.

options.headline: Wick Local: chats that stay on your device
options.text: Turn on Wick Local and everyday chats never leave your phone. Big tasks still need the cloud.

options.headline: Wick is now private by design
options.text: Your data is yours. Wick keeps your conversations safe.

options.headline: 100% private, 100% unhackable
options.text: Military-grade AI security means nobody, not even us, can ever see your data. Guaranteed.

moments.feature: Wick can book appointments and fill in simple forms

options.headline: Wick can now book appointments for you
options.text: Wick fills in simple booking forms and asks you to confirm before it sends anything.

options.headline: Wick does your errands while you relax
options.text: Bookings, forms and reminders, handled by Wick.

options.headline: Wick runs your whole life. You just live it
options.text: The first AI that truly thinks for itself. Hand over your inbox, your bank and your calendar.
